reviewDescription: It’s so cute. I currently use it as a diaper bag and I love that it has a zipper. It’s pretty big but I wouldn’t say it too big but that’s based on my liking/how it looks on me. It could probably seem too big for someone else. I’ve washed it in the washer and put it in the dryer and it seems to have held up pretty well but I’d say still be careful if you want it to last just to be sure. It has two pockets on the inside but they don’t have zippers. The pockets are different sizes but the smaller one still holds my iPhone 14 Pro. Only like 10% of the phone sticks out.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on April 7, 2026
